title: `SynthToken` returns incorrect name, symbol, and decimals
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  SynthToken incorrectly attempts to override inherited ERC20 state variables by declaring new private variables `_name` and `_symbol`.
